name: Oji-san Tomete - Iede Gyaru to no Win Win Sex Life
original_name: オジサン泊めて 家出ギャルとのWINWINセックスライフ
source:
"Hey! Please! I'm not asking for a handout, I'll do whatever you want." 

On my way home I always saw this teenage girl. She made me feel my age as I noted her young, healthy hair and her perfect legs. Made me think about my wasted youth. We boarded the same train but of course I didn't think to chat her up. Someone like her and someone like me, no way it could happen. But not only was she talking to me, the thing she was saying... 

"I'll do anything you want," 

what did that mean? She had her schoolgirl carry bag. It clicked. She wasn't going home like me. She was just going somewhere. A runaway. Any other life situation and she'd be running from me. Of course I thought it. In this moment I was powerfully aroused. Maybe the power, her sexuality. I liked that she was desperate. 

"I'll do whatever you want." 

That could only mean one thing. I took her home. My predictable, boring life could afford a few waves from a stone thrown in the pond. Whatever came next I could handle, was my attitude as I embraced this interesting experience.
